run_preprocess_anet_entities: run the ActivityNet-Entities dataset preprocessing script to convert raw annotations to NP/object annotation files
extract_attr_from_database: extract all attributes from video bounding box annotations in the ActivityNet database for train and val splits
define_train_val_test_split: define train, validation, and test splits from ActivityNet caption files with a 50/50 val-test split
freq_obj_list_with_nlp: generate object class list using Stanford CoreNLP lemmatization and frequency threshold filtering on noun phrases
prep_all_database_with_noun_phrases: preprocess the full database to create noun phrase annotations with object class labels and bounding boxes
